status.comment: Preproduction package and crate topology only; no agent supervision or reattachment is implemented by this bootstrap.

p.identity: The package coordinate is org.vibevm.podbay/podbay at preproduction version 0.1.0. PodBay is an independent OS runtime. Zap may consume PodBay through its public contract; PodBay has no dependency on Zap.

p.roles: Coordinator and worker are roles of the same pod model. Their exact identity, resource and control semantics belong to the separately approved PodBay API surface and subsequent specifications. This foundation does not claim that either role can be launched.

p.crates: The Cargo workspace contains core, store, host, pod, client and CLI crates. Core has no internal dependency; store, host and client depend on core; pod depends on core and store; CLI depends on core and client. Pod does not depend on the manager-facing host crate. Pod-local spool and adapter crates may be added later without reversing this direction.

p.boundary: The binaries intentionally refuse operational use in this bootstrap. Durable process ownership, exact reattachment, output replay, command fencing, PTY attachment and an optional ACP gateway require later implementations and focused conformance evidence. This package does not migrate Zap state or launch a live agent.
